sessions.title: Grounding
sessions.intention: Settling into the body and the floor beneath it.

sessions.title: Release
sessions.intention: Letting go of what you have been bracing against.

sessions.title: Change
sessions.intention: Meeting a transition without gripping the old shape.

sessions.title: The Heart Tone
sessions.intention: Softening toward yourself. The one most people return to.

sessions.title: Connection
sessions.intention: Repair, warmth, and the people you want closer.

sessions.title: Intuition
sessions.intention: Clearing the noise so your own voice is audible again.

sessions.title: Clarity
sessions.intention: Seeing the situation as it is rather than as it was.

sessions.title: Expanse
sessions.intention: Spaciousness. Best used at the end of a practice.

sessions.title: Night Tone
sessions.intention: A low, slow tone for the end of the day.
